criteria.requirement: Identical immutable subject, consumer profile, evidence set and ruleset produce identical RFC 8785 canonical report bytes and SHA-256 fingerprint.
Report schema/version, ruleset version, provenance and all five dimension results are present and schema-validated before return.
Exact subject release/digest/EFS and consumer/profile/range coordinates are preserved; no latest resolution or fallback occurs.
Opaque contract values remain exact and are never parsed or normalized as SemVer.
Compatible, breaking, conditional and unknown outcomes retain stable rule IDs, evidence, conditions, mappings, warnings and blockers; missing/malformed evaluator evidence remains unknown.
Every output conforms to the dedicated Draft 2020-12 compatibility report schema; invalid or extra fields are rejected.
Report is a derived artifact and does not mutate source release coordinates, manifests or digests.

Specification evaluation directly invokes the PSI-47 EFS supported-range evaluator and preserves PSI-48 outcomes: match, evidenced non-match, invalid/missing range and missing evidence are not conflated.
Exact subject Factory release and EFS version coordinates are validated by PSI-47's field-aware SemVer parser without normalization.
The evaluated specification coordinates must match the exact report subject efsVersion and consumer profile/range; inconsistent caller-supplied assessments are rejected.
